post.description: For EURid (.eu), transfer-out is not supported and this endpoint returns 422 with code FEATURE_NOT_SUPPORTED.

Retrieves the domain auth/EPP code. For EURid (.eu), the backend may first request authInfo generation if no code is currently active. If the registrar still does not provide a code, returns 502 with code AUTH_CODE_UNAVAILABLE. This endpoint retrieves the auth/EPP code for use in outbound transfers. For tracking the outbound transfer lifecycle, use POST /domains/{id}/transfer-out/start.

post.description: Admin-only recovery action. Creates a tracking-only inbound transfer run for an existing domain without invoking registrar transfer APIs. Requires Idempotency-Key header.
Creates a tracking-only outbound transfer run. No registrar API call is made. Records the transfer lifecycle for monitoring. Requires Idempotency-Key header.

Returns a single transfer run with its full event timeline and available actions.

post.description: Resends the admin approval email via NameSilo for an inbound transfer. Only supported for NameSilo transfers in action_required status.
Resubmits a transfer to the registry via NameSilo. Only supported for NameSilo transfers in action_required status.
Queues an unlock operation for the domain associated with a transfer run.
Archives a domain from a failed or timed-out inbound transfer. Admin only. Sets the domain to suspended/archived status atomically.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: Client-generated idempotency key for safe retries.

CorrelationID.name: X-Correlation-ID
CorrelationID.description: Client-provided correlation id. Generated server-side when omitted.

DomainRegisterRequest.description: For EURid registrations, provide nsgroups and do not send nameservers.

handle.description: Requested registrar contact ID/handle. Optional for NIC.it in normal UI flows because the backend generates one; required with at least 3 characters for EURid.

auto_renew.description: Whether auto-renew is enabled at the registrar

password.description: Required when auth_source is local; must be omitted for api_key service accounts.

auth_source.description: Set to api_key to create a passwordless service account.

registrar.description: If omitted, resolved from TLD extension

auto_renew.description: Whether auto-renew is enabled at the registrar

locked.description: Whether the domain is locked at the registrar

privacy_enabled.description: Whether WHOIS privacy is enabled at the registrar

nsgroups.description: NSGroup names to associate with the domain (EURid)

open_current_domains.description: Distinct domains with at least one open latest-key discrepancy.

critical_current_records.description: Open latest-key discrepancy records with critical severity.

action.description: Action identifier (empty string for guidance-only entries)

relaxed_manual_import_enabled.description: Whether the relaxed/manual import feature is configured and available

CreateAPIKeyRequest.description: Provide exactly one of user_id or username to select the service account.

api_key.description: Raw API key. Returned only once, at creation; never retrievable again.
